overview_description.description:
Hunter2 is an online learning platform for software engineers. Hunter2 teaches modern secure coding practices through interactive web apps that developers exploit and patch. Hunter2's training labs center around real-world scenarios to teach engineers how modern web apps can be hacked, and how to avoid these vulnerabilities.

Hunter2 launched out of Y Combinator's winter 2018 class.
